source.name: ERA5 reanalysis precipitation via Open-Meteo archive

query.caveat: Only the monsoon season is published; off-season days are omitted because the fetch is rate-limited, not because they are unavailable.
query.rate_limit_note: Calls are spaced by at least 10 s with retries=6; a 429 stops the stage so the next run resumes from cached (year, chunk) pairs.
query.grid_definition: regular 0.5 degree cell-centre nodes from lon 89.5 to 96.5 and lat 23.5 to 28.5; 15 x 11 = 165 nodes

source.licence: Open-Meteo data; ERA5 (ECMWF/Copernicus Climate Change Service) reanalysis, CC BY 4.0
source.caveat: ERA5 is a model-based reanalysis, not a gauge or satellite observation, and it is biased in complex terrain. It is sampled at 0.5 degree nodes (stride-2 of the native 0.25 degree grid) because the native request volume exceeds the free-tier rate limit; district areal means are therefore smoother than the native product, especially along the Himalayan and Barail margins. Only the monsoon season is published; off-season days are omitted because the fetch is rate-limited, not because they are unavailable.
source.retrieval_note: The archive response is cached per (year, chunk); retrieved_at is the build time of this published file. The published series is the ordered JJAS window only.

series.label: ERA5 daily precipitation (AOI areal mean)
series.source_note: Area-weighted mean of the 0.25 degree ERA5 grid over the Assam state polygon, JJAS 06-01..09-30 only. Reanalysis, not a gauge observation.
